definitions.gloss: to get injured, to get hurt
definitions.explanation: To sustain a physical injury. Can refer to minor cuts and bruises or more serious injuries.

examples.japanese: サッカーでけがしました。
けがしないように{気|き}をつけてね。
examples.english: Be careful not to get hurt.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}をけがしてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up injuring my leg.

notes:
けが can be written as {怪我|けが} in kanji but is often written in hiragana.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- けがをする: to get injured (with を)
- けがする: to get injured (without を, casual)
- 〜をけがする: to injure (body part)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- けがをさせる: to injure someone
- けがが{治|なお}る: injury heals
- {大|おお}けが: serious injury
- {軽|かる}いけが: minor injury

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (けがする) and transitive (けがさせる)
